text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Sorry. My head muscles are a little sore…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Yeah. It's a throbbing kind of pain, like when you overuse a muscle that's out of shape.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I dunno why. Is it because I've been studying more than usual for my tests?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Or… is it because I keep thinking about what's gonna happen next in the manga I've been reading?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ow… Even talking too loud hurts…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It looks like Mejiro Ryan is struggling with a migraine.
